# Glossary {#sec-glossary}

Application protocol (AP)
:   A part of ISO 10303 that defines the scope and the schema for a particular use, for example AP 242 for mechanical design.

Entity
:   A type declared in an EXPRESS schema. Instances of entities make up the data section of a STEP file.

Entity instance
:   One record in the data section, identified by a number such as `#42`.

EXPRESS
:   The data modelling language, defined in ISO 10303-11, used to write every schema in the standard.

Part 21 file
:   A file encoded according to ISO 10303-21, the clear text encoding. This is what people mean by "a STEP file".

PMI
:   Product manufacturing information: dimensions, tolerances, surface finish, notes, and other annotations attached to the geometry.

Schema
:   A collection of EXPRESS declarations. A STEP file names the schema it conforms to in its `FILE_SCHEMA` header entity.
